newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Grande mulls address shift to Bermuda.
newsitem.headline: Grande mulls address shift to Bermuda.

text.p: Consumer and computer products manufacturer and distributor Grande Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had proposed changing the registered address of the company to Bermuda from the Cayman Islands.

"In view of the continuing expansion of the group's business especially with overseas customers to whom Bermuda is a more familiar location than the Cayman Islands...the establishment of the company's registered address in Bermuda would better serve the group's business needs," it said in a statement.
The company said the move might also enhance the reputation of the group among international investors.
It said the proposal would not require any change in the existing shareholding structure and would not affect its listing status in Hong Kong.
The company said further information regarding the proposal would be released as soon as practicable.
Grande shares were up HK$0.15 to HK$3.20 in afternoon trade.
